final: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.state_county_province AS s, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers cu ON a.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT s, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM av)) AS avg_excess FROM sh WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM av)
